title: Portfolio V2 — Sanity CMS Integration & Layout Redesign
description: Integrate Sanity CMS into portfolio-v2. Replace all hardcoded TypeScript data with Sanity-fetched content. Set up Sanity Studio, schemas, GROQ queries, draft mode, webhooks. Update profile with mobile number and daily.dev. Redesign layout and styling.

context.goal: Portfolio V2 powered by Sanity CMS with live editing

architecture.dataFlow: Sanity API → GROQ queries → Server Components → Frontend
architecture.caching: Next.js ISR + tag-based revalidation via webhooks
